_comment: SEEDLING FIDELITY F1 — the GAME's own Bob readouts (botMobiles, every sampled tick, seedling_bot_ap_p4e headless). r8-solve-5 (L5, from t54) and r8-solve-4 (L4's bob@64,64, from t83) are the two campaign segments whose arrow-shoved bodies left the model before the arrows' update order was transcribed (levelRun.arrowUpdateOrder). f1-l5-lock-removal and f1-l5-open-lock-bait are F1's own witnesses (L5's lock on the removal; the open-lock arrival's surviving body). Produced by `node scripts/procgen/probe-seedling-u9-shield-mobiles.mjs --tape=<name> --class=Bob --out=<file>`, keeping the game half of each row. Row: [t, x, y, vx, vy, hits, hits_timer]. Read by fidelityF1.test.js. `unsampled` lists the ticks the probe's poll did not land on (it samples by polling, and on f1-l5-open-lock-bait it read 437 of 438 ticks); every other tick in [0, tick_count] was sampled, so a tick with no row there is a tick with no Bob. ⛓ Fidelity F1c re-sampled r8-solve-5 after the chain's re-record (403 t, crossing to L6 on t403): the same command, 404 ticks sampled, 524 rows, worst |Δ| 1.4e-14 against the model.
